notes.title: Update : Save is now fixed for everyone!
notes.content:
Hello Kickers team !

We now have found out the bug that corrupt save files for some players.
Everyone should be able to save properly now! 

What will be your next match?

No rules, no referees !

notes.title: Halloween Sale is Here! W've got some sweet underwater stuff for you...
notes.content:
Ready to get scared... or not!

Halloween is the right time to enjoy some candies! Our colored teams from Super Kickers League are awaiting you for a nice match!

You really desserve a quiet match to chill out between two horror games sessions!

Super Kickers League and its DLCs is now 70% OFF during the Halloween Steam Sale ! 

Grab it before it ends! You can also pick up the Ultimate bundle, including the spooky DLC Goths & Vampires as well as the glorious Vikings & Valkyries DLC for 25% off more!

If you want to get even more sweeties... Please take a look at our Fantasy Friends franchise, who is currently up to 50% OFF !

notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year with Super Kickers League !
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Chinese New Year ![/h1]

This year, in 2021,  we celebrate the ox... and you probably noticed that you can throw a cow on your enemies in Super Kickers League Ultimate if you're playing Sammy Riley, the captain of the Yippie Ki-Yay's team !
[i][b]The Game is now 80% off to kick even more![/b][/i]

This offer is running until Feb 14th !

notes.title: New Language added!
notes.content:
Hello Kickers!

Here is a small update on Super Kickers League that bring to our dutch friends their native languages : Dutch !

If you want to participate and bring your own language into Super Kickers League, just reach us ! :D

Enjoy your next kicks!
